purpose: Teach: に当たって/満たし/満たさ/遂げ/併せ/略し/測っ/揃える

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究に当たって心得を伝える
lines.en: Ren — before you go further with this research, there are principles I need to pass along.
lines.style: Measured, deliberate opening. Sits back slightly. The cadence of someone about to offer something hard-won. Not unkind, but weighty. Pauses after the name — a beat that says 'this matters.'

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会の要件を満たしております
lines.en: Yes, understood. I've reviewed the conference requirements thoroughly.
lines.style: Quick, clean affirmation. Slight forward lean — eager to show he's already on it. Respectful but not obsequious. The tone of someone who wants to be trusted, not patronised.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、品質を満たさないデータは発表するな
lines.en: And Ren — if the data doesn't meet the standard, you don't publish it. Not yet.
lines.style: Slower this time. Eyes level. The firmness comes from quiet conviction, not volume. A pause before 'you don't publish' — letting the weight land. Not a threat. A line in the sand.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。博士を遂げたく存じます
lines.en: Yes. I want to do this properly — I want to earn this doctorate the right way.
lines.style: Soft but steady. Not asking permission. The sincerity underneath the formal register shows. Voice holds ground but doesn't push back. Slight catch — he means it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、共同研究者と併せて論文を書け
lines.en: Good. Now — sit down with your collaborators and write the paper together. That's non-negotiable.
lines.style: Brisk, matter-of-fact. The shift to action. No softening. Commands attention without raising volume. A tap of finality in 'non-negotiable' — this is the threshold between advice and instruction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文タイトルを略してキャッチーにしました
lines.en: Yes. I've already outlined it with them — kept the title sharp and focused so it would stand out.
lines.style: Quicker tempo — he's anticipating the next point. Pride in the work but not defensiveness. Reports like someone who knows his ground. A small lift of certainty on 'sharp and focused.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、実験を測ってご報告しろ
lines.en: Measure it carefully. Then report back to me — everything, not the highlights.
lines.style: Quiet, almost clipped at the start. Then softens slightly on the second sentence — not suspicious, just precise. The emphasis falls on 'everything' — steady and clear. Expects accuracy.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究データを揃えるよう努めております
lines.en: Understood. I'm working to pull the data together now — making sure nothing slips through.
lines.style: Focused, slightly quieter than before. The fatigue of care shows — he's checking and rechecking. Not anxious, but conscientious. Voice tapers at the end, like he's already turning back to the work.
